description: FINE-TUNING v2 - Full Dataset Training (steps_per_epoch=0). Continues from thin_stroke_fix_v1_souibgui best checkpoint (ckpt-99). OBJECTIVE: Expose model to ENTIRE training set (not just 100 steps/epoch) for deeper convergence and better generalization. STRATEGY: Lower LR (5x reduction) to prevent catastrophic forgetting, longer training (100 epochs), conservative early stopping. Expected: CER <15%, PSNR >25, Thin Stroke >75%, better handling of edge cases and rare degradation patterns.

parent_results.note: Model trained on SUBSET of data (100 steps/epoch × batch_size=2 = 200 samples/epoch)

experiment_metadata.hypothesis: Parent experiment (thin_stroke_fix_v1) trained on LIMITED data subset (100 steps/epoch). By exposing model to FULL DATASET (steps_per_epoch=0 = ALL samples), model will: (1) Learn rare degradation patterns not seen in subset, (2) Reduce overfitting to specific subset samples, (3) Improve generalization to test set, (4) Achieve lower CER through better text understanding. Risk: Longer training time (~10x) but better convergence.

steps_per_epoch.reason: CRITICAL - Use FULL dataset instead of 100-step subset. steps_per_epoch=0 means 'use all available samples'. Estimated ~5000-10000 steps/epoch (depending on tfrecord size). This exposes model to ENTIRE data distribution.

epochs.reason: Compensate for full dataset usage. With full data, each epoch is more meaningful, so can train longer. Early stopping (patience=15) will prevent overtraining.

lr_g.reason: CRITICAL - 5x LOWER LR (0.0002 → 0.00004) for fine-tuning from checkpoint. Prevents catastrophic forgetting of learned weights. This is CONSERVATIVE fine-tuning, not aggressive retraining.

lr_d.reason: Match Generator LR reduction. Keep G and D learning rates synchronized.

save_interval.reason: Reduce checkpoint frequency to save disk space. With full dataset, each epoch takes longer, so saving every 5 epochs is sufficient.

patience.reason: Reduce patience since we're fine-tuning (not training from scratch). Model should converge faster from good starting point.

min_delta.reason: More sensitive early stopping for fine-tuning. Expect smaller incremental improvements from already-good checkpoint.

warmup_epochs.reason: Shorter warmup since starting from trained checkpoint (not random initialization).

annealing_epochs.reason: Longer annealing window for full dataset training. Gradual LR decay over 30 epochs for fine-tuning stability.

max_checkpoints.reason: Keep more checkpoints for analysis. With save_interval=5, this covers 25 epochs of history.

resume.reason: CRITICAL - Enable checkpoint resumption to continue from parent experiment.

resume_from.reason: CRITICAL - Load best checkpoint from parent experiment as starting point.

no_restore.reason: Allow weight restoration from checkpoint (opposite of no_restore).

loss_weights.note: UNCHANGED from parent - Keep proven loss balance from Souibgui-inspired config

expected_improvements.generalization: Better test set performance (less overfitting to 100-step subset)
expected_improvements.edge_cases: Handle rare degradation patterns not seen in subset

training_time_estimate.current_v2: 100 epochs × ~5000 steps × 2 batch = 500K steps (~20-30 hours with early stopping)
training_time_estimate.note: Expect ~10x longer training time but significant quality improvement

validation_strategy.compare_with_parent: Test on SAME held-out set as parent experiment
validation_strategy.decision_criteria: If CER > parent after 30 epochs → stop and investigate

next_steps.if_partial_success: Analyze which degradation types improved vs degraded
next_steps.if_failure: Revert to parent checkpoint, try intermediate steps_per_epoch (e.g., 500)
